biology.mechanism: Adhesive three-dimensional hyphal networks capture nematode worms.
Nematode ascaroside signals can induce traps under nutrient limitation; environmental context matters.
Three ring cells inflate inward to capture a passing nematode. Reported inflation time: 0.1–1 second.
A 2017 study found attraction to fungal volatile compounds; methyl 3-methyl-2-butenoate showed species-, sex- and stage-dependent effects supporting proposed olfactory mimicry.
